mapper.select: SELECT pm.id, pm.product_id, pm.management_status, pm.priority, pm.assignee, pm.expected_completion_time, pm.actual_completion_time, pm.management_notes, pm.create_time, pm.update_time, p.name as product_name, p.product_sn, b.name as brand_name, pc.name as category_name FROM product_management pm LEFT JOIN pms_product p ON pm.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN pms_brand b ON p.brand_id = b.id LEFT JOIN pms_product_category pc ON p.product_category_id = pc.id WHERE pm.id = #{id}
